notes.title: New game version 1.4.12
notes.content:
What's new:
- Fixed a bug with the maximum FPS setting; now this feature works (I got 2200 FPS on my computer)
- Fixed an error in the Ru localization

notes.title: New patch 1.4.11
notes.content:
Hello there! The game has been updated to version 1.4.11. Here’s what’s new:
1. Added support for Linux and SteamOS.
2. Added the ability to remap controls.
3. Updated the settings menu with tabs for better user convenience.
4. Added an option to adjust the max FPS. Unfortunately, this feature is currently not working but will be fixed in the next patch.
5. Added a hint on how to play with a friend online via Steam Remote Play Together.

That’s all for now. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New game patch 1.4.10
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone! I've released a new patch for the game, version 1.4.10, which includes:
1. Fixed a freeze that occurred when switching music in Music Pack 2.
2. Significantly reduced the game’s size (from 232 MB to 130 MB).
3. Fixed errors in some Portuguese (Brazilian) translations.
4. Bots in the main menu no longer stop playing even after 30+ minutes.

That’s all for now! Next week, I plan to add builds for Linux and Steam Deck.

If you’d like to see more levels and gameplay modifiers in Strange Pong - please let me know!
